These are upstream product surfaces, not automatic Hoplight adapter capabilities.

anchors.summary: Profiles Display Name About Me Behavior defers full field semantics to Characters Convo tab Conversation Mode only. That destination owns Convo Display Name with declare-on-card checkbox for characters, About Me auto-list defaults and per-chat override popout badges, update_about_me Public versus Chat scopes with Tool Use, Convo Behavior insertion modes Constant after or before card Append Prepend Replace post-history or Only where convo_behavior is placed, and Conversation-only macros convo_display char_about persona_about convo_behavior. Auto About listing and Behavior insertion run without macros; macros place values in custom prompts. Fields never apply in Roleplay or Game.

Getting started defines Conversation as messenger-style continuing relationship state whose profiles, presence, autonomous messages, schedules, reactions, selfies, calls, and table games do not apply in Roleplay or Game. Its four-step wizard assigns Name and Connection, Prompt Preset, Persona and Characters, then Automation. Autonomous Messages starts on and Generate Schedules off. Optional packages add a master Commands gate plus up to seventeen families for schedule updates, cross-post, selfies, memories, scenes, music, haptics, connected-chat influence or notes, calls, reactions, and six games. User presence is global Active, Idle, Do Not Disturb, or Invisible with a 120-character activity; DND suppresses autonomous messages while Idle does not.

Schedules and autonomous messaging live in Conversation Chat Settings. Autonomous Messages defaults on. Chat Check-In Cap uses talkativeness ceilings of eight, six, five, three, or two daily, or a positive whole-number chat ceiling; character limits only lower it. Schedules default off and provide generated weekly routines, per-character day editors, and stale-aware routine summaries. Tuning selects five talkativeness levels, 15-360 minute wait with 120 default, and five enabled check-in moments. Advanced timing sets Default or 1-8 daily safety, optional Away 0-120 delay with random 1-3 blank default, and Busy 0-120 with random 2-5. Rewrite, Adjust, Vary, or Repair changes a draft only until Save. Daily Online/Away/Busy/Offline blocks affect initiation; temporary status does not rewrite the schedule. Manual user presence disables automatic Idle until Active returns.

Custom emojis, stickers, and GIFs are Conversation-only beyond the plain emoji picker. Emoji names are one to thirty-two lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores, unique, at most 256 by 256, and may be animated GIFs. Edit mode renames, deletes, exports a self-contained marinara-custom-emojis JSON, and imports while skipping invalid or colliding items; deleted shortcodes remain text in history. Stickers use a parallel lifecycle with 512 by 512 limit and Send and reply versus Add to message. Giphy search needs a key, has fixed mature rating, and no offline safe-only source. Gallery assets can receive profile-scoped tags without copying. Per-chat selection is Semantic with local/random fallback, Random, or Tool-call with semantic fallback and multi-speaker skip; Max offered defaults twenty in range one to one hundred. Reactions use only global emoji.

Calls require the optional package, per-chat Audio/Video Calls, and global Call Audio Pipeline even for typed use; TTS is optional and unresolved voices become text-only. Input modes are Local Whisper recording default, browser speech with fallback, manual dictation, and provider-native audio/video, the only mode allowing camera or screen. Per-chat defaults are calls off, character Calls command on, and voice cues on; pipeline, camera, video presence, automatic clips, and custom clips are global and off. Incoming calls always need Answer or Decline; active calls persist in a popout. Soundboard has four immutable built-ins plus mp3/wav/ogg/webm/m4a uploads to 8 MB. Video Presence uses per-character Idle, Talking, Laughing, Angry, Crying, and Sighing Clips, distinct from Gallery Videos; automation creates only missing Idle and Talking. Disabling video presence disables its two child toggles. Call-end summary enters chat history.

Selfies are Conversation-only Illustrator image events. Commands and Generated Selfies must be enabled. Per-chat settings are required Selfie Connection initially None, Prompt Model default Main chat model, Image Style default global profile, Send Avatar References off and provider-dependent, Attach Card Appearance off, and Resolution default 896x1152 with five alternate presets. A character may invoke the hidden command, while the user can request from Gallery and choose a group member. Expose media prompts before sending allows review and editing; Cancel sends no image request. Each completed selfie consumes one selected-connection request and is not a Roleplay scene background.

Table games are six optional Conversation packages: UNO, Chess, Poker, 8-Ball Pool, Tic-Tac-Toe, and Rock-Paper-Scissors. Installation immediately exposes slash, chat-phrase, and separately gated character-invitation paths. One game may exist per chat and at least one character is required. UNO seats two to ten with hand seven and missed-UNO penalty on; Chess is one-on-one with Random color; Poker seats two to eight with silent house dealer, stack 1000, small blind 10, and zero-valued no-doubling/no-hand-limit defaults; Pool is one-on-one Race to 1/3/5; Tic-Tac-Toe selects X/O/Random; RPS is best of 3/5/7. Boards enforce legality and use the chat connection for narration. Early End or Resign deletes state and records no winner. Command toggles stop autonomous invitations but not slash or phrase starts.

Hoplight treats Conversation Mode as a Marinara product surface. Schedules, call media, emoji libraries, and table-game state are not hosted or converted unless a future adapter proves that support with canonical mappings and fixtures. Kit must not infer codec support from this product guide alone.

docs.title: Marinara data and SillyTavern import
docs.summary: DATA_DIR layout, encryption key, backup zip versus profile export/restore, and exact SillyTavern import non-transfer list, folder access rules, and wizard handling.
docs.semanticSummary: Documents Marinara data layout backup restore and SillyTavern import at the pinned Engine docs. DATA_DIR layout lists storage plus asset folders and the encryption key file or ENCRYPTION_KEY env for API secrets. Backup versus profile contrasts Download Backup full zip restorable via Import Profile Export Profile Native restorable and Export Profile Compatible non-restorable. Restore scans then confirms irreversible import with identity match re-import updates media warnings and secrets stripped requiring re-entered keys and webhooks. SillyTavern single-file import covers Character Chat Preset Lorebook carriers and embedded book prompts. Folder wizard access requires loopback free path remote admin secret or IMPORT_ALLOWED_ROOTS. Folder wizard stages path scan seven categories built-in preset default unchecked tag and regex modes progress and results. Wizard handling rules are best-effort branch grouping group Roleplay import and source date preservation. What does not transfer enumerates global settings Quick Replies non-selected categories and failed items. Hoplight hub conversion is not this wizard.

anchors.summary: DATA_DIR layout holds all user content default data beside the server or Docker app data with a storage log line showing the resolved path after restart. Storage holds characters chats messages lorebooks presets connections as structured records. Asset folders include avatars sprites backgrounds gallery fonts knowledge-sources game-assets custom-emojis custom-stickers for media that is not row storage. The encryption-key file decrypts stored API keys and must travel with data or keys are re-entered; ENCRYPTION_KEY env can replace the file when operators prefer env injection. Mobile backup download includes the key when present so restores stay decryptable on device handoff.

Backup versus profile contrasts three Advanced Backup and Export actions under remote Admin Access when needed. Download Backup is a full zip of storage settings media RESTORE text and encryption key when present and is restorable via Import Profile accepting backup zip. Export Profile Native yields account plus media as marinara-profile json or zip if large and is restorable through the same Import Profile path. Export Profile Compatible is a zip of plain character persona lore for other tools and is not Import Profile restorable so operators must not expect full account recovery from Compatible alone.

Restore uses Imports Import Profile for JSON or ZIP packages. Scan then confirm because the step cannot undo once applied. Recent profiles match by item identity so re-import updates in place; very old profiles can duplicate objects instead of merging. Missing media yields amber warning while the rest of the profile still imports. Secrets are stripped from profile exports so authors must re-enter API keys and webhooks after restore before connections work again.

SillyTavern single-file import under Settings Imports accepts Character JSON or PNG Chat JSONL always as Roleplay with switch Preset JSON and Lorebook JSON carriers. Embedded character books may prompt standalone lorebook import after card intake. Quick buttons set all tags and regex Character only for batch convenience. Characters panel Import exposes tag mode and regex scope for finer control. Chat list import uses the open mode tab for CONVO RP or GM rather than a mode field inside the JSONL file.

Folder wizard access is free on loopback. A remote browser needs the server admin secret plus Settings Advanced Admin Access. IMPORT_ALLOWED_ROOTS rejects typed paths outside configured roots while Browse and in-app picker paths remain allowed. Disallowed typed roots fail closed.

Folder wizard stages begin with path to ST root data or public inside then Scan Folder. Authors choose categories Characters Chats Group Chats Presets Lorebooks Backgrounds Personas with built-in ST presets default deterministic neutral universal star starting unchecked so bulk import does not silently take stock templates. Tag mode is All No or Existing only default All and Regex is Character only or Global. Progress runs per item then results show counts per-item failure lines and Done.

Wizard handling is best-effort, so one failure records a warning and continues. Several chat files for one character import as branches of one chat. Group chats always import as Roleplay. Imported items retain the source last-changed date rather than the import time.

What does not transfer enumerates the documented non-transfer list without deferring to vague upstream prose. Only the seven scanned categories are read by the wizard. Global app settings and Quick Replies are not read and not imported under any category toggle. Built-in ST presets stay out unless the author explicitly checks them. Failed conversion items are skipped and listed in warnings rather than aborting the whole batch. Secrets and non-selected categories do not come over into Marinara storage.

Hoplight hub-and-spoke conversion is not Marinara's folder-import wizard. Kit must not claim that Hoplight runs this ST bulk importer, restores Marinara profiles, or preserves DATA_DIR encryption keys without a dedicated implemented path and tests. The wizard's categories, access rules, and loss boundaries describe upstream Marinara behavior only.

docs.title: Marinara lorebooks
docs.summary: Complete Marinara lorebook lifecycle: categories, global versus linked mutual exclusion, overview defaults, entry types keys position timing recursion, folders, budgets and skip reasons, semantic search, and export loss.
docs.semanticSummary: Documents complete Marinara lorebook lifecycle at the pinned Engine docs. What a lorebook is defines keyword injection without API plus opt-in semantic matching. Library panel covers create import multi-export folders OFF badge and categories World Character NPC Spellbook Other. Activation how a book becomes active separates Global mutually exclusive with links Linked character or persona activation and Chat-pinned books plus Enabled kill switch. Overview defaults list Scan Depth Token Budget Entry Limit Max Depth Recursive and Vectors with defaults. Entries cover keys types Selective logic position depth order probability timing flags folders and recursion. Budgets and skips name per-book and chat-wide caps Entry Limit trim order and Active Context skip reasons. Semantic search covers embedding sources query score vector limits and quiet failures. Linking and ownership separates shared linked embedded promoted and chat-pinned books. Import export names native marinara json compatible folderless JSON bulk native zip date preservation and required re-vectorization after import. Hoplight mapping is adapter-specific.

anchors.summary: A lorebook or World Info holds entries with keys and content. Matching recent chat injects eligible content into the prompt. Keyword matching needs no API. Semantic matching is opt-in per book and requires embeddings when enabled. This runtime behavior does not by itself prove cross-format conversion.

Library panel provides New Import Select multi-export delete search by name description linked names tags sort A-Z Z-A Newest Oldest Token Budget Copy Delete library folders separate from in-book entry folders OFF badge when disabled and picture upload. Categories child documents World Character NPC Spellbook Other labels and All Active per-category tabs. Category does not change activation rules; Active means relevant to the open chat.

children.summary: Categories assign each book one label World Character NPC Spellbook or Other. Overview may label Other as Uncategorized. Tabs are All Active relevant to open chat and per-category filters. Category is organizational and never changes activation rules by itself.

anchors.summary: Activation how a book becomes active uses three paths. Global Overview switch applies every chat while enabled and is mutually exclusive with character or persona links so enabling Global clears links on save. Linked books auto-activate in chats that include that entity. Pinned books attach to one chat via chat Settings Lorebooks. Enabled must be on or no entries fire even if global or linked. Chat Settings can edit the active list.

Overview defaults are Scan Depth two for recent messages zero whole chat Token Budget two thousand forty-eight zero unlimited Entry Limit one hundred range one to one thousand Max Depth three recursive passes range one to ten Enabled on Recursive off Vectors off for semantic embeddings. Treat these as book-level starting values not chat-wide caps.

Entries autosave with states and require a name. Content and keys cover Primary Keys Secondary Keys Description matching toggles and token estimates. Types are Normal Constant Selective with secondary AND Any All NOT Any NOT All. Position depth order probability set injection placement and chance. Timing covers Sticky Cooldown Delay Ephemeral. Additional entry flags from entries guide include Role at Depth group tag filters Locked No Vector context filters and per-entry Recursion. Folders group entries with folder enable clone delete multi-select.

children.summary: Content and keys use Primary Keys as chip keywords default case-insensitive substring. Content is injected text with macros and live token estimate. Secondary Keys are Selective only. Description is Knowledge Router only never main AI content. Matching toggles Whole Words Case Sensitive Regex with safety timeout and slow pattern failure for that scan.

Types are Normal primary keys match Constant no keyword still respecting timing probability filters budgets and Selective primary plus secondary logic AND Any AND All NOT Any NOT All. Type choice changes activation cost and should match author intent.

Position depth order probability set Position Before chat After chat or at Depth default depth four Order default one hundred lower earlier and Probability default one hundred percent. Depth placement interacts with Role flags when using at Depth insertion.
Timing fields are Sticky Cooldown Delay in messages and Ephemeral in activations with zero meaning off. They gate how often Constant or matched entries reappear across the chat window.

Additional entry flags from entries guide include Role for at Depth insertion group or tag filters Locked No Vector skip semantic context filters and per-entry Recursion whether this entry text can chain. These are distinct from book-level Recursive switch.

anchors.summary: Budgets and skips use per-book Token Budget and chat-wide Lorebook Token Budget chat Settings default eight thousand one hundred ninety-two zero unlimited. Entry Limit is a count cap separate from tokens. Trim order Constants first then matches on latest message then remaining injection order. After a skip later smaller entries may still fit. Active Context lists skips with reasons lorebook budget chat budget or both shows keywords size budget used and may suggest Knowledge Retrieval or Router agents. Recursion does not bypass budgets or Entry Limit.

Semantic search requires an embedding source connection embedding model example text-embedding-3-small or Local Model sidecar when installed Lite may hide local. Vectors switch per book. Settings Query Messages default ten zero full history Score Threshold default zero point three Vector Limit default ten semantic matches only. Vectorize missing or re-vectorize with confirm. Dimension mismatch or missing vectors fail quietly for those entries while keywords still work. Semantic and keyword matches share budget priority with configured order breaking ties.

Linking and ownership separates shared linked library books attached to characters or personas from embedded books that travel inside a character card when export includes them. Character import can promote an embedded book to a standalone linked Marinara lorebook or leave it only inside the card. Chat-pinned books are chat-owned activation not library membership. Global versus linked mutual exclusion remains. Manage embedded books from character Lorebook tab and Native export which keeps attached lorebooks.

Import export detects Marinara native versus foreign World Info or V2 character-book JSON automatically. Import single or bulk drop shows per-file success or error rows and preserves created date from the source file. Export Marinara Native marinara json includes folders and every field or Compatible JSON folderless World Info drops Marinara-only details. Bulk export Select Export marinara-lorebooks zip always Native. ST folder wizard can pull lorebooks with other categories. After import child documents re-vectorization requirements for semantic search.

children.summary: After import keywords work immediately. Semantic search requires re-vectorization after import using Vectors plus Vectorize missing or Re-vectorize. Old vectors from another install are not assumed valid for the new embedding model.

anchors.summary: Hoplight canonical lorebook mapping is adapter-specific. Marinara token budgets, recursive controls, semantic vectors, folder structure, timing fields, and activation ownership do not automatically round-trip through every target. Kit must consult the active format adapter and report unsupported fields instead of presenting cross-format export as silently lossless.

docs.title: Marinara documented macro catalog
docs.summary: Exhaustive catalog of every built-in prompt macro named by the pinned Marinara Engine macros guide, with signatures, aliases, returns, scopes, and failure modes.
docs.semanticSummary: Exhaustive catalog of every built-in prompt macro named by Pasta-Devs/Marinara-Engine prompts/macros.md at commit b7545a63e7e264a1cd9eeea1a5490d50c08ddb29. Built-ins are case-insensitive; unknown letter-number-underscore names resolve as preset variables or remain literal; the page does not invent extension macros; live Macro Reference and slash macros are engine authorities. Identity and card macros list user userName userNamePhonetic char charName charNamePhonetic characters group persona personaDescription personaPersonality personaBackstory personaAppearance personaScenario description personality backstory appearance scenario example charSysInfo charPostHistory with defaults and group first-character behavior. Conversation Mode only covers convo_display char_about persona_about convo_behavior emptying outside that mode. Conversation placement move suppress auto-insert covers context status commands commandList reactRules emojiReact replyRules memories memoryRecall lorebook lore and singular about placement rules. Context and request macros list input model chatId lastGenerationType idle_duration gameStoryboardKeyframeCount agent type resolved last. Time macros share one browser-timezone timestamp for date time datetime isotime weekday timezone. Random and dice cover random ranges weighted options and roll XdY. Reply-scoped variables setvar getvar addvar incvar decvar reset each generation with setvar-in-random failure mode. Formatting macros cover newline trim case wrap noop comment banned. Non-macros and failure modes plus Conditionals pointer complete the contract.

anchors.summary: Identity and card macros: user and userName return active user or persona display name defaulting to User; userNamePhonetic falls back to user when empty. char and charName return current character name defaulting to Character; charNamePhonetic falls back to char. characters is all chat characters comma-joined; group is other active group characters excluding current responder and excludes persona, following current speaker during group generations. persona joins Description Personality Backstory Appearance Scenario by newlines; personaDescription personaPersonality personaBackstory personaAppearance personaScenario return single persona fields. description personality backstory appearance scenario example return character fields with solo current character or group first character by default unless group blocks iterate. charSysInfo is Character System Prompt; charPostHistory is Character Post-History Instructions.

Conversation Mode only macros are convo_display char_about persona_about and convo_behavior. They resolve only in Conversation Mode authoring surfaces and remain empty or unused in Roleplay and Game. Pair them with Convo tab fields on characters and personas rather than inventing Roleplay injection paths.

Conversation placement (move + suppress auto-insert) macros render a block at the macro site and skip automatic insertion to avoid duplication, Conversation Mode only. context and status place conversation context or status block. commands and commandList place available-commands reminder. reactRules and emojiReact place custom-emoji reaction rules. replyRules places custom-emoji and sticker reply rules. memories and memoryRecall place memory-recall block. lorebook and lore place lorebook injections. In one-character Conversation, placing char_about or persona_about yourself similarly skips the automatic participant About block. Group Conversation keeps the automatic participant block because a singular about macro covers only one participant.

Context and request macros: input is the most recent user message available to the prompt. model is current model name when selected. chatId is current chat ID. lastGenerationType labels generation reason with documented examples normal continue regenerate impersonate guided autonomous turn_game preview game_setup lorebook_scan retry_agents as an open set. idle_duration is human-readable idle time such as 8 minutes. gameStoryboardKeyframeCount is Game Mode keyframes-per-turn target 1-6 default 3 as narrative target not a hard paragraph quota. agent double-colon TYPE returns saved output of agent type TYPE and is resolved last so agent text cannot inject further macros.

Time macros all share one resolution timestamp with timezone from the browser. date is YYYY-MM-DD. time is HH:MM 24-hour. datetime and isotime are full timestamps with timezone offset and the same meaning. weekday is weekday name. timezone is timezone name. Do not invent per-macro clock skew; treat them as one snapshot.

Random and dice: random alone is integer 0-100 inclusive. random colon X colon Y is integer between X and Y inclusive. random double-colon A double-colon B double-colon C picks one option and macros resolve only inside the chosen option. Weighted form uses option at weight with missing weight equal 1, decimal weights allowed, weight 0 never selected, all weights 0 yields empty, and only a final at-number is a weight. roll colon XdY returns dice total such as 2d6.

Reply-scoped variables exist only for one reply generation and reset every turn. setvar name value stores and emits empty. getvar name reads or empty if unset. addvar name value appends to stored value. incvar name adds 1 to numeric variable. decvar name subtracts 1 from numeric variable. Do not put setvar inside random options because setvar runs for every option before the pick.

Formatting macros: newline and escaped-n insert a line break. trim removes itself and trims surrounding whitespace. trimStart and trimEnd trim start or end of surrounding text. uppercase and lowercase wrap text for case conversion. noop is removed as a harmless placeholder. double-slash comment is an author note removed from output. banned quoted text is removed and does not filter or ban model output.

Lifecycle rules pinned state that built-in macros need no API key and resolve inside Marinara while preset variables need a defining preset. Agent type macros stay empty until that agent has produced saved output and resolve last so agent text cannot inject further macros. Variables evaluate left to right in one prompt build so early lore setvar can be read later. Random resolves macros only inside the chosen option except setvar addvar incvar decvar which run for every option before the pick. Reply-scoped variables reset every generation. Weighted random missing weight equals one weight zero never selected all-zero weights yield empty.

Non-macros and failure modes: prompt alone opens Peek Prompt and is not a resolving macro. No escape character for braces; unknown names stay literal unless a preset variable matches. Custom Tools do not resolve macros. Impersonate templates accept only a restricted placeholder set, not the full list. Very large or deeply nested expansions are cut off silently. Live slash macros and Macro Reference may update with the engine; this catalog is the pinned static floor and must not invent extension macros.

Conditionals: operators live on Prompts and macros including if blocks, else, equality and comparison operators, and logical and or. They are part of the macro system and apply wherever macros work. This catalog does not re-list operator tables; treat that page as the normative operator reference and this page as the exhaustive name catalog.

docs.title: Marinara maps, game assets, HUDs, and storyboards
docs.summary: Hierarchical map nodes AI draft enable save movement lore links; game assets; sessions; eight HUD widgets; party NPC GM modes; storyboard keyframes; scenes; trackers and Secret Plot lifecycle.
docs.semanticSummary: Documents Marinara hierarchical maps, Game assets, sessions, HUD widgets, party and NPC state, storyboards, Conversation-branched scenes, Roleplay trackers, and Narrative Director at the pinned Engine docs. Maps cover package and per-chat activation, authoring fields, AI draft review, explicit enable and save, exact-location lore, one-move travel, bindings, import, archive, and history-safe IDs. Game assets cover five categories, browser lifecycle, exact formats and limits, music path grammar, protected starter content, per-game folder selection, and local/admin device folders. Sessions cover immutable setup sharing, conclude and resume, read-only replay, editable history, spoiler state, autosave, and non-restorable checkpoints. Game and Roleplay HUDs remain distinct. Party, Scene, storyboard, and Secret Plot sections preserve their separate ownership and destructive boundaries. Hoplight makes no unproven game-state conversion claim.

anchors.summary: Hierarchical maps Roleplay and Game require package install via Download Agents restart and per-chat enable not global. Limits are up to five hundred locations and twenty hierarchy levels preferring wide sibling floors. Each location has parent children siblings type Region Settlement Place Building Floor Room public description private AI notes lorebook entries on exact location and one-way or two-way links any-to-any with children as list positioned map or ordered layers. Workflow Create map Draft with AI Draft preview search select regenerate Continue to editor set start location Enabled plus Save. Draft and import only change working copy until enable and save. Travel Story map set destination next message commits move; AI cannot relocate by narration alone. Path details nearby destinations and eligible lore can enter context. Import export of map files is chat-owned map state.

Game assets have Music Ambient Sound Effects Sprites and Backgrounds categories. Asset Browser offers folder tree and breadcrumbs, grid or list, search, upload and drop, subfolders, rename, move, copy, delete, download, multi-select, notes, pagination, and rescan. Bundled CC0 starter assets are protected from move and delete; backgrounds start empty. Audio accepts MP3 OGG WAV FLAC M4A AAC WebM; sprites accept PNG JPG JPEG GIF WebP AVIF SVG; backgrounds exclude SVG. Audio and images cap at 50 MB, text at 10 MB. Music requires state genre intensity with four states, ten genres, and three intensities. Each Game may exclude folders without deleting them. Music DJ can use a Game Assets path or local device folder, with local or admin gating for device access. This is separate from Roleplay and Conversation media.

Game campaigns use numbered sessions. End Session accepts an optional next-session direction up to 5000 characters and generates a conclusion; New Session resumes from its summary and direction. Initial Game Setup is an immutable shareable snapshot of adventure, cast, model, prompt, effective parameters, visuals, storyboards, and world tools, excluding credentials endpoints keys database IDs and bundled content. Completed entries can include summaries, resume, party dynamics, discoveries, character moments, recall details, NPC updates, requested continuation, stats, and party status. Replay is read-only and recorded-choice only. Edit Details changes notes; Regenerate replaces them; Update Plot Arcs revises hidden plans. Show Spoilers reveals and edits hidden world and campaign state with invalid JSON rejected. State autosaves and checkpoints at session and combat boundaries, but checkpoints have no restore UI. Custom HUDs are reviewed before session start.

HUD widgets Game default on in setup wizard with up to four left and right. Types are Progress Bar Gauge Relationship Meter Counter Stat Block List Inventory Grid Timer. Pre-session Review Starting Widgets edit or remove before Start Game and Prepare Next Session Widgets on continue. During play GM updates manual edit collapse lock unlock drag double-click lock or R resets position. Layout is per game with import export of widget layouts where documented. Roleplay uses separate HUD trackers not the Game widget set.

Party bar sheets hold identity, level, class, HP, status, attributes, abilities, and inventory, with AI regenerate and manual edit. Recruit and remove change Game membership rather than Roleplay group-chat membership. Adventure Journal separates generated story records from Player Notes. NPC reputation has seven ordered labels from Hostile to Ally, with detail and meter views. Game Master modes govern NPC visibility and private notes without converting NPCs into user-controlled party members.

Storyboards Game only run after GM narration turn producing one to six keyframes default three from stripped GM tags. Stills go to Gallery Images and clips to Videos. Requires Game Illustrator image connection with error if missing. Manual Create storyboard and Automatic Storyboard Illustrations after each turn wizard default on when Visual Generation on. Expose prompts means manual reviews each keyframe while automatic does not pause. Send Avatar References improves consistency. gameStoryboardKeyframeCount supplies target count to GM prompts.

A Scene is a temporary Roleplay branched from Conversation with slash scene or slash rp, POV, tense, instructions, its own background, stage, opening, and messages. The origin retains an active-scene link. End Scene writes a generated memory summary to the origin; Discard deletes without write-back; Convert detaches it into a permanent Roleplay without summary or memory. Clone from here copies through one message while keeping the original active. Scenes deliberately exclude Connected Chat steering and history so they remain self-contained; use Connected Chats for continuous influence. Gallery media stays owned by the Scene chat and is distinct from its backdrop.

Roleplay has World State, Persona Stats, Present Characters, Inventory, Active Quests, and Custom Tracker widgets. Popovers save manual edits immediately. Lock mode protects chosen values; schedules and refresh rerun one or all trackers; Clear Trackers is irreversible. The larger Tracker Panel adds custom field structure, add delete lock and hide modes. Hiding Mood Look Outfit or Thoughts clears and locks it; omitted agent output does not erase author fields. Narrative Director is Roleplay-only. Push Story arms one Natural or Random Event instruction for the next reply. Secret Plot is off by default and updates a hidden arc every 1 to 100 assistant replies, default 8. Reveal supports arc, protagonist, one character, completion, save, and confirmed regenerate. Clearing runs or memory retains the arc; removing Narrative Director deletes it irreversibly.

Hoplight makes no claim of full Marinara game-state conversion. Hierarchical maps, asset selection, sessions, widgets, storyboards, scenes, party state, trackers, and Secret Plot remain platform-owned unless a future adapter maps each field and lifecycle through the canonical model with round-trip fixtures. Unknown state must be escrowed or reported rather than silently flattened.

docs.title: Marinara prompts and macros
docs.summary: Macro rules, conditionals, preset variables, preset editor lifecycle, overrides, chat-settings presets, and exact generation parameter ranges, Send toggles, prefill, thinking tags, custom parameters, and precedence.
docs.semanticSummary: Documents Marinara macro rules, conditionals, preset variables, the full prompt-preset lifecycle, media prompt overrides, Chat Settings Presets, and generation controls at the pinned Engine docs. It routes exact built-in names to the macro catalog while preserving evaluation rules and live /macros authority. Prompt presets cover panel organization, explicit save and dirty-exit behavior, Overview Sections Prompts tabs, live markers, groups, wrap formats, depth placement, assignment, Conversation and Game single-prompt differences, and Peek Prompt verification. Media overrides cover registered image and video templates, variables, preview, active paused default states, and reset. Chat Settings Presets bundle connection, prompt source, agents, tools, translation, memory, and advanced parameters while excluding chat content, with mode defaults and JSON interchange. Generation controls give ranges, Send defaults, provider extras, and baseline to connection to chat precedence. Hoplight preserves macro text without executing it.

anchors.summary: Macro system rules use syntax double-brace tags; built-ins are case-insensitive and always on in macro-enabled fields. Fields include character and persona prose and advanced prompts, lorebook Description and Content, preset sections, regex Find Replace Trim, agent templates, and chat input. Nested macros resolve. Custom Tools do not resolve macros. Reply-scoped variables reset every generation; setvar inside random options runs for all options. Unknown NAME becomes a preset variable if defined else left literal under the literal braces strategy. The prompt tag alone opens Peek Prompt rather than expansion. Impersonate templates use a restricted placeholder set. Huge nested expansions may be silently truncated. Live Macro Reference UI and slash macros and macro commands are engine-generated authorities that outrank static documentation for installation-specific discovery.

Conditionals use if cond, else if, else, and end-if blocks. Operators are equality double-equals equals is, inequality not-equals is not, numeric greater less greater-or-equal less-or-equal, and contains or includes with not-forms. Equality uses numbers if both numeric else case-insensitive text. Numeric compares are false if non-numeric. Logical and binds before or; parentheses are allowed. Compact equality allows character equals A or B style lists. Group blocks iterate multi-character contexts per conditional-prompts. Truthy checks without operator are supported. First true branch wins; discarded branches are not resolved.

Preset variables exist on section-based presets only, not Conversation single-override mode. Names use letters numbers underscores. Kinds are single-choice, boolean toggle with one option, multi-select, and multi-select plus random pick. Options have Label and Value. Configure modal on assign offers Save as default, Skip, or Confirm; Confirm requires every single-choice filled. Edit preset variables from chat settings. Switching presets clears choices. Do not treat preset variables as free global env for every chat mode.

The Presets panel supports create, JSON import, multi-select export or delete, search, four sort orders, folders, and a starred default. New presets require a name; edits do not autosave and dirty exit offers Keep editing, Discard, or Save and close. Overview holds name, description, author, and XML Markdown or None wrap format. Sections combine macro-aware Prompt Blocks with live Character Info, Persona, Chat History, Chat Summary, Dialogue Examples, and Lorebook markers. Missing lore markers warn; examples append to Character Info only when no explicit examples marker exists. Sections expose role, enable, duplicate, delete, order, group, and ordered or depth placement. Agent Sections insert the matching agent result. Prompts holds Conversation and Game single prompts while Roleplay uses assembled sections. Roleplay presets require chat assignment. Conversation and Game choose a source, may become chat-local Custom, and Game adds 2000 characters of instructions. Peek Prompt reveals the final request.

Prompt Overrides are reusable image and video generation templates under Settings Generations, not chat-prompt section patches. The image registry covers selfies, portraits, sprites, scenes, storyboards, Game NPCs, Noodle images, and other image builders; video covers scenes, Conversation Call clips, and animated expressions. Each editor selects a registered template, shows Default, Custom active, or Custom paused, inserts only listed dollar-brace variables, renders example values, and warns about unknown variables. Save activates the override, Apply this override off preserves but pauses it, and Reset to Default removes it after confirmation. It has no effect unless the corresponding media feature and generation connection run.

Chat Settings Presets work in Conversation and Roleplay, not Game. They bundle connection, prompt preset or Conversation source, agents, tools, translation, Memory Recall, Advanced Parameters, and related behavior, while excluding characters, persona, lorebooks, sprites, summary, tags, and scene prompt. Upload covers single name upload preferring transparent PNG, quick-add suggested expression names, Upload Folder basenames with happy_01 and happy_blush as variants of happy, and Manage Frame Download Replace Delete plus multi-delete All Expressions or All Full-Body. Cleanup and export offers erase paint undo reset previews and file download without assuming PNG card export embeds the full set. Galleries are ordered media for character or persona with upload of common image formats optional video download and delete per item. Custom emoji and sticker tagging from gallery uses scope profile versus chat and naming size rules matching Conversation custom media limits one to thirty-two char lowercase names max two hundred fifty-six pixels. Failure rejects oversized or invalid format at upload. Galleries are not expression grids and not scene backgrounds. Preserve these rules in Kit answers without inventing adapter support.

Colors exact fields leave empty for theme defaults. Extract Colors from Avatar disabled until avatar exists. Name Display Color colors the name and supports CSS gradients such as linear-gradient ninety deg amber to red and also tints sidebar tabs or persona pickers. Dialogue Highlight Color colors quoted dialogue text example gold and works with quote styles optional bold from Settings. Message Box Color is bubble background prefer semi-transparent rgba. Message box applies Conversation and Roleplay. Preserve these rules in Kit answers without inventing adapter support.

Stats values are starting defaults for new chats while agents change them during play. Character Enable RPG Stats adds Pools HP MP one hundred of one hundred default add remove color and Attributes STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA default ten. Off shows nothing and sends nothing. Persona Enable Persona Stats status bars Satiety Energy Hygiene Mood one hundred of one hundred and Enable RPG Attributes same pools attributes as characters. Agents Character Tracker updates character RPG and persona RPG attributes Persona Stats agent updates status bars. Without agents defaults stay fixed. HUD shows enabled stats as gradient bars.

Hoplight: cross-format cards usually lose sprites, galleries, colors, and stats unless a native Marinara pack is used. Report those losses honestly during conversion. anchors.summary: Card CSS theming embeds style blocks in character or persona Creator Notes. Chat Settings Card Theming appears only when an active character in the chat has CSS persona CSS alone does not show the control. Modes Disabled default Exclusive each character CSS only its messages Chat all card CSS affects whole chat area. Engine sanitizes dangerous CSS scopes to chat and injects over app message styles. Selectors must stay under data-card-css chat surfaces message bubble name content. Linear Conversation layout has no mari-message-bubble while Bubbles and Roleplay do. Forbidden styling outside chat breakout to app chrome unsafe constructs stripped. Export ownership CSS rides Creator Notes on Marinara Native character persona export compatible CCv2 PNG does not preserve custom CSS as a first-class field.

Style profiles live under Settings Generations Image Generation Style Profiles. Ten built-ins Off Auto default Anime Danbooru Illustrious Realistic SDXL Photorealistic Cinematic Digital Painting Painterly Fantasy Z-Image Turbo Narrative. Clone creates editable copy and sets it default Reset restores built-ins Delete user clones only when more than one profile exists. Prompt grammar Hybrid Danbooru tags Tags Natural language. Style text positive negative tags per-image-kind tags avatar portrait selfie background illustration sprite. Test bench validates. Precedence app default connection override chat override later wins. Cleaning regenerates tags from style text.

Scene background generation works in Roleplay and Game, not Conversation. Gallery Background builds a 1280 by 720 default prompt from current setting, location, weather, and time, uses the Illustrator connection or image default, saves to the background library, and applies immediately; missing connection fails. Gallery conditionally exposes Illustrate, Selfie, Background, Video, storyboard, and image browsing. Per-image actions open, pin, download, animate, copy saved prompt, and confirm delete. The library accepts JPG PNG GIF WebP and AVIF up to 20 MB; user assets can rename tag delete while built-ins are read-only. Roleplay may pin a chat background or let the optional Background agent select existing library images after replies. That agent never generates. Backdrops cross-fade and fall back to solid color.

Duration is 1 to 8 seconds default 3 and output is 512 pixels wide. GIF output skips sheet slicing, cropping, and background cleanup; the transparent-style option is only a prompt hint and cannot guarantee transparency. Prompt exposure reviews every expression.
